yaaw-orchestrator.description: Continue or recover a YAAW project by reconstructing reality and dispatching the next safe workflow.

yaaw-prd.description: Create or continue YAAW product definition, challenge material product assumptions, and route clarification or revision work.

yaaw-revise-prd.description: Change accepted YAAW product intent and invalidate downstream engineering contracts whose basis became stale.

yaaw-refine-prd.description: Improve clarity and completeness of a YAAW product artifact without changing accepted product meaning.

yaaw-planner.description: Continue repository-backed YAAW engineering planning, challenge material technical assumptions, and advance decisions, readiness, specifications, or tickets.

yaaw-planning-review.description: Freshly assess whether the current YAAW engineering frontier is ready for implementation without material invention.

yaaw-create-spec.description: Create the next YAAW specification from an engineering frontier whose readiness is currently PASS.

yaaw-create-ticket.description: Create bounded YAAW implementation ticket contracts from the current accepted specification.

yaaw-create-tickets.description: Create dependency-aware bounded YAAW implementation tickets from the current accepted specification.

yaaw-implement.description: Implement one admitted READY YAAW ticket and produce repository-identity-bound verification evidence.

yaaw-repair.description: Repair a YAAW ticket in REPAIR_REQUIRED state while preserving its accepted product and engineering contract.

yaaw-review.description: Independently review actual YAAW implementation and classify PASS, REPAIR, REPLAN, or BLOCKED against current evidence.
